summary: The Phase 1 security audit passes at dd66da7e3. The new bind step passes its SHA to the script as one argv element, checks the SHA before any Git use, holds no secret, no env, and no apt-get, runs before every secretEnv step and before migrate-db, and fails closed on every error path with a trap that removes the scratch folder. The .gcloudignore of the upload is compared, the measure/ line removes the only tracked link in the upload scope, no traffic step reads a file under measure/, and no hash or checksum field exists beyond git hash-object.
evidence: Provenance: `git rev-parse HEAD` prints dd66da7e33d7a0dccce5ffb50bf8a449beb0265c, equal to role_base_sha and audited_head_sha. `git diff --stat dd66da7e3 HEAD -- .gcloudignore apps/sales-advantage scripts/ci docs/runbooks/traffic-moves.md measure/tracks/sales_traffic_source_binding_20261108 measure/tracks.md` prints nothing (exit 0). The audited HEAD is current.

Phase base: `git rev-parse 157e45cc5^` prints 7c853d9baf1700f4a78e19c70fbfc355bdfcca57, equal to phase_base_sha; `git log -1 --format='%h %s' 7c853d9ba` names the strategy commit docs(measure): add the traffic binding strategy.

Scope: the track commits 157e45cc5, ee58b8961, 11ab03e8f, 0a042ccbb, 97784e4e9, 2c949f16d, 794f2d22f, 3a63eeb14, e29d8d0cf, dd66da7e3 change only scripts/ci/verify-traffic-source.sh, scripts/ci/__tests__/sales-traffic-source-binding.test.mjs, scripts/ci/__tests__/cloudbuild-files.test.mjs, apps/sales-advantage/cloudbuild-traffic.yaml, docs/runbooks/traffic-moves.md, .gcloudignore, and paths under measure/tracks/sales_traffic_source_binding_20261108/. The 18 other commits in 7c853d9ba..dd66da7e3 belong to storytime_look_20261107 and per_app_cicd_20261107 and are out of scope.

Point 1, no shell injection: apps/sales-advantage/cloudbuild-traffic.yaml lines 13-20 hold `entrypoint: "bash"` with an `args` list of four elements and no `-c` string, so $_RELEASE_COMMIT_SHA reaches scripts/ci/verify-traffic-source.sh as one argv element ($1). `grep -n -E 'waitFor|continueOn' apps/sales-advantage/cloudbuild-traffic.yaml` exits 1. S-28 in scripts/ci/__tests__/sales-traffic-source-binding.test.mjs lines 1163-1171 asserts the exact four-element args array.

Point 2, SHA check before Git use: scripts/ci/verify-traffic-source.sh lines 110-113 reject any commit that is empty or holds a character outside [0-9a-f], then require length 40, and the first Git use of the value is line 129 `git fetch ... origin "$commit"`. A value starting with `-` fails the `*[!0-9a-f]*` case, so it cannot become an option. Lines 115-117 reject an empty or dash-leading URL. The value is quoted at lines 129, 130, 134, and 141.

Point 3, no secret and fixed URL: the bind step at apps/sales-advantage/cloudbuild-traffic.yaml lines 13-20 holds no secretEnv, no env, and no apt-get, and names the image gcr.io/cloud-builders/git. The URL is the fixed literal https://github.com/Reading-Advantage-Thailand/reading-advantage-monorepo.git at line 19. scripts/ci/verify-traffic-source.sh line 36 sets GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0, so a private URL fails instead of prompting for a credential.

Point 4, step order: a parse of the steps of apps/sales-advantage/cloudbuild-traffic.yaml gives idx=0 id=bind-release-source secretEnv=False, idx=1 verify-curriculum-backup secretEnv=False, idx=2 migrate-db secretEnv=True, and secretEnv=True on idx 3, 5, 6, 7, 9. The bind step is index 0, so it runs before every secretEnv step and before migrate-db.

Point 5, fail-closed: scripts/ci/verify-traffic-source.sh lines 48-50 make a missing tool exit 1 with the tool name; line 134 fails when the commit holds no .gcloudignore; lines 129-130 fail when the fetch fails or the commit is absent; lines 168-170 and 190-193 set bad=1 on any missing:, extra:, or differs: line and exit 1; line 123 sets trap cleanup EXIT, and cleanup at lines 53-57 removes the scratch folder. `bash -n scripts/ci/verify-traffic-source.sh` exits 0.

Point 6, the .gcloudignore of the upload is compared: scripts/ci/verify-traffic-source.sh line 134 loads the .gcloudignore of the commit into a file, and line 145 applies it as core.excludesFile to the commit paths, so both sides use the same rules. `git ls-files -s .gcloudignore` prints 100644 ff0103c0a8ae23fe209fec7de8c658c61d26d540, so .gcloudignore is a tracked file inside the upload scope and its blob id is compared. `git rev-parse dd66da7e3:.gcloudignore` and `git rev-parse HEAD:.gcloudignore` both print ff0103c0a8ae23fe209fec7de8c658c61d26d540.

Point 7, fork-commit limit D10, recorded for the PM and not a violation: `git ls-files -s | awk '$1=="120000"'` prints six tracked links. GitHub's upload-pack serves a commit object reachable from the upstream refs, and a fork's pull-request commits are reachable through the upstream refs/pull/* refs, so the upstream URL can serve a commit that exists only in a fork. The check therefore binds the upload to the named commit, not to a commit of master. measure/tracks/sales_traffic_source_binding_20261108/spec.md line 47 and line 61 and docs/runbooks/traffic-moves.md line 153 claim no more than the code delivers. The PM owns a change of this limit (D10).

Point 8, R-L1 holds: `git ls-files -s | awk '$1=="120000"'` prints 6 links. With the current .gcloudignore, `git -c core.excludesFile=<repo>/.gcloudignore check-ignore --no-index -v --stdin` prints all 6 as excluded and exits 0; the measure link is excluded by .gcloudignore line 32 `measure/` and the five apps/advantage-games links by .gcloudignore line 3 `apps/*`. The control with the base .gcloudignore of 7c853d9ba excludes only 5 and leaves the measure link in scope. `git show 794f2d22f:.gcloudignore | grep -c '^measure/$'` prints 1.

Point 8, no traffic step reads a file under measure/: `grep -n "measure" apps/sales-advantage/cloudbuild-traffic.yaml apps/sales-advantage/cloudbuild.yaml apps/sales-advantage/cloudbuild.continue-f5063222.yaml apps/sales-advantage/Dockerfile apps/accounts/cloudbuild-traffic.yaml apps/accounts/cloudbuild.yaml apps/accounts/Dockerfile apps/accounting/cloudbuild-traffic.yaml apps/accounting/cloudbuild.yaml apps/accounting/Dockerfile apps/codecamp-advantage/cloudbuild-traffic.yaml apps/codecamp-advantage/cloudbuild.yaml apps/codecamp-advantage/Dockerfile apps/marketing/cloudbuild-traffic.yaml apps/marketing/cloudbuild.yaml apps/marketing/Dockerfile apps/www-reading-advantage/cloudbuild.yaml apps/www-reading-advantage/Dockerfile` exits 1. `grep -n "measure" scripts/ci/*.sh scripts/ci/*.mjs` exits 1. `grep -n "measure" apps/primary-advantage/cloudbuild-traffic.yaml` exits 1.

Point 9, no extra hash or checksum: `rg -n -i 'sha256|sha-256|sha256sum|sha1sum|shasum|md5sum|openssl dgst|checksum|createHash|manifest' scripts/ci/verify-traffic-source.sh` exits 1. The only hash tool is git hash-object at scripts/ci/verify-traffic-source.sh lines 181 and 185. The sha256sum at apps/sales-advantage/cloudbuild-traffic.yaml line 98 belongs to the pre-existing step verify-repair-verify-legacy-rollback and sits outside the bind step. This follows the AGENTS.md hashing policy, which prefers Git commit and tree identity.

A2, consent-blind publish gate: not applicable. `rg -n -i 'publish|draft|consent|anonymi'` over the phase diff of .gcloudignore, apps/sales-advantage, scripts/ci, and docs/runbooks/traffic-moves.md exits 1, so the phase holds no publish gate and no named subject.

A6, registry overstatement: no hit. measure/tracks.md line 1638 records the track as `- [ ] **Track: Bind the traffic sources to the release commit**` with Status: new, and the entry states that the live traffic runs stay `deferred:daniel`. The registry claims no resolved security state. docs/runbooks/traffic-moves.md line 192 states that no traffic file has run and that the files are checked as text only.

findings_resolution.D10 fork-commit limit: Recorded as a limit for the PM, not as a violation. The upstream URL can serve a fork-only commit by SHA, so the check binds the upload to the named commit, not to a commit of master. The spec and the runbook claim no more than the code delivers, and the PM owns a change of the limit.

recorded_limits_for_pm: D10 fork-commit limit: GitHub can serve a fork-only commit by SHA through the upstream URL (refs/pull/*), so the check binds the upload to the named commit, not to a commit of master. The spec and runbook claim no more. Default: keep the current limit; the PM owns a change (D10).
